newsitem.title: USA: First Data shr drop seen as buy opportunity.
newsitem.headline: First Data shr drop seen as buy opportunity.

text.p: A continued slump in the shares of First Data Corp is viewed as a buying opportunity by some analysts who believe the data processing company will continue to show 20 percent growth over the long haul despite forecasts of a slight slowdown this year.

First Data shares have fallen about $4, or 10 percent, since Thursday when the company said 1997 earnings would be about $1.60 per share, 18.5 percent more than 1996 operating earnings of $1.35 per share. The decline has come on heavy volume, with the stock prominent on the active list.
